testsuite.name: com.wingedsheep.gameserver.FreeForAllLobbyTest

testcase.name: 3-player premade FFA pod: one game, mid-game concede continues, standings = elimination order, play again
FFA lobby seats AI players and caps the pod at 6
a Two-Headed Giant lobby seats AI teammates and opponents
switching a lobby holding AI players to a multiplayer table is allowed
an AI seated in a premade-decks pod is dealt a deck, the way a quick game rolls one
the host picks each AI seat's deck separately, and only that seat's changes
choosing an AI's deck is refused in a limited lobby, where it builds from its pool
a Commander premade lobby deals an AI its own commander deck, and the host can override it
a premade lobby holding an AI re-rolls its deck when the host switches to Commander
a sealed FFA pod of one human and two AI builds its decks, starts, and the AI plays
4-player Commander FFA pod: every seat starts at 40 life with its own commander in its own command zone
4-player Commander FFA pod reached explicitly through the Rules axis, with no deck-format restriction
Two-Headed Giant refuses Commander rules before touching submitted decks
switching a Commander lobby to Two-Headed Giant is refused at the switch, not at Start
